info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Edenitec Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to submit detailed information about the Edenitec Recliner for cataloging purposes. It facilitates the addition of new products to the catalog by capturing essential details such as specifications, features, and pricing. Typical consumers of this API include product managers, inventory systems, and e-commerce platforms looking to enhance their product offerings. The API ensures that information is accurately recorded and made accessible for further processing and display in product listings.
